datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule for Burkina Faso in 2022. Geographic polygons were classified into IPC phases representing acute food insecurity severity, with scenario projections and assistance requirements recorded for each administrative unit.
